answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that grows only with proven honest work, like tending a garden: a new identity starts as a single ember with tiny limits, and only a long record of useful, verifiable tasks lifts it toward the zenith of full trust. Spawning thousands of fakes then means locking thousands of stakes and waiting months, while bad behaviour burns the stake, so a Sybil flood stays weak and expensive.
